blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reasoning through video generation offers a promising path toward visual intelligence by modeling latent visual states and their dynamics. However, current video generation models often lack explicit guidance on how these states should evolve, leaving generated trajectories prone to physical and structural inconsistencies that undermine reasoning reliability. While the Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) provides rich spatiotemporal priors learned through latent prediction, these general priors do not naturally adapt to the logical reasoning capabilities required for complex visual tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose VR-JEPA, a framework that aligns the V-JEPA predictor with task-specific reasoning logic through localized contrastive-state learning and uses its predicted latent trajectories to guide video generation for visual reasoning. Specifically, (i) we pair successful trajectories with generated alternatives under the same input conditions and use discrepancies in their V-JEPA representations to identify informative states and tokens for localized contrastive supervision. (ii) We further equip the V-JEPA predictor with skill-specific experts trained on anchor-task data, allowing the model to adaptively specialize its shared spatiotemporal priors across diverse cognitive domains.
Together with skill-specific experts, this contrastive supervision enables VR-JEPA to predict latent trajectories that provide task-specific logical guidance for video generation. Comprehensive experiments on the large-scale VBVR-Pro-Bench dataset demonstrate that VR-JEPA achieves an 11.33 % 11.33\% relative improvement over the cutting-edge generation-based reasoning baseline, significantly mitigating physical artifacts and enhancing logical consistency.

与技能特异性专家一道,这种对比性监督使VR-JEPA能够预测潜在的轨迹,为视频生成提供特定任务逻辑指导. 大型VBVR-Pro-Bench数据集的综合实验表明,VR-JEPA比尖端的生成推理基线实现11.33%的相对改善,显著减轻了物理文物,提高了逻辑一致性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Anticipating how the world will change is central to planning and problem solving, motivating world models that support prediction and decision making ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Micheli et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ) . Video generation provides a setting for examining predicted scene evolution: it renders intermediate state transitions and final outcomes as a sequence. Diffusion models have made substantial progress in generating realistic and temporally coherent videos ( Ho et al., 2022 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ) .
However, their denoising objective does not by itself ensure that generated transitions satisfy a task’s requirements. A video may look convincing while moving the wrong object or depicting an incorrect object relation. This gap motivates guidance that links generated state changes to task requirements ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
展望世界将如何变化,是规划和解决问题的核心,激励支持预测和决策的世界模型(Ha和Schmidhuber,2018年;Micheili等人,2023年;Du等人,2024年;Xiang等人,2025年)。 视频生成为检查预测的场景演化提供了一个环境:它使中间状态过渡和最终结果作为一个序列. 传播模式在制作现实和时间上一致的视频方面取得了重大进展(Ho等人,2022年;Blatmann等人,2023年)。
然而,他们发号施令的目标本身并不能确保所产生的过渡满足任务的要求。 视频在移动错误对象或描绘错误对象关系时可能显得令人信服. 这一差距促使指导将国家变化与任务要求联系起来(Liu等人,2026年;Cheng等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: The Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) offers pretrained spatiotemporal representations that can support such guidance. By predicting visual features rather than pixels, it captures scene content and motion while reducing emphasis on appearance details ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) . Yet representing how a scene evolves is not the same as predicting how it should evolve to satisfy an instruction. A predictor may track an object’s motion while missing the spatial relation that motion must establish. Furthermore, different tasks also require distinct reasoning skills, such as understanding physical interactions, comparing quantities, and inferring abstract rules. A predictor built on V-JEPA features must therefore focus on task-relevant transitions and adapt to diverse reasoning requirements. Its predicted trajectories should guide video generation toward sequences that satisfy these requirements.
blocks.zh: 视频联合预测架构(V-JEPA)提供经过预先培训的可支持这种指导的瞬间表示。 它通过预测视觉特征而不是像素,捕捉场景内容和运动,同时减少对外观细节的强调(Bardes等人,2024年). 然而,代表一个场景如何演化与预测它应如何演化以满足一个指令不同. 预测者可以跟踪物体的运动,同时忽略运动必须确定的空间关系。 此外,不同的任务也需要不同的推理技能,如理解物理相互作用,比较数量,推导抽象规则. 因此,基于V-JEPA特征的预测器必须侧重于与任务有关的过渡,并适应不同的推理要求。 它的预测轨迹应该引导视频生成向符合这些要求的序列.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce VR-JEPA , a framework that predicts task-relevant trajectories in a latent space derived from V-JEPA features and uses them to guide video generation (Figure 1 ). Given an initial scene and an instruction, a learned predictor autoregressively produces a sequence of compact latent states describing the desired scene evolution. These states condition a video diffusion model, separating the prediction of task-relevant states from visual synthesis.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了VR-JEPA(VR-JEPA),这个框架预测了V-JEPA特征衍生的潜在空间中与任务相关的轨迹,并利用这些轨迹指导视频生成(图1)。 根据初始场景和指示,一个学习的预测器自动地产生一系列紧凑的潜伏状态,描述所期望的场景演化. 这些状态为视频传播模型的条件,将任务相关状态的预测与视觉合成区分开来.

blocks.en: Specifically, to make latent prediction more sensitive to task-relevant changes, VR-JEPA trains the predictor with localized contrastive-state learning. A solution may depend on only a few object movements or changes in inter-object relations, while many other visual details are incidental. We pair successful reference trajectories with task-matched generated candidates and use discrepancies in their V-JEPA features as a heuristic for weighting contrastive supervision at the state and token levels. This encourages predicted rollouts to follow the reference evolution rather than merely capture generic scene motion. Complementing this focused supervision, VR-JEPA incorporates a skill-routed mixture of experts (SR-MoE) to model heterogeneous state transitions. Lightweight residual experts are first trained on representative anchor tasks; a sparse, state-conditioned router then learns to combine them as the rollout evolves, using the predictor’s training objectives without expert-assignment labels.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,为了使潜在预测对与任务相关的变化更加敏感,VR-JEPA通过局部对比态学习来培训预测器. 一个解决方案可能只取决于几个对象运动或对象间关系的变化,而许多其他视觉细节则是偶然的. 我们把成功的参考轨迹与任务相匹配的生成的考生进行配对,并将他们的V-JEPA特征中的差异用作在州级和象征级进行对比性加权监督的弹性。 这鼓励预测的推出遵循参考演进,而不是仅仅抓住一般场景运动. 为了补充这种重点突出的监督,VR-JEPA采用了由专家组成的技术组合(SR-MOE),以模拟各种不同的国家过渡。 轻量级剩余专家首先接受关于代表性锚地任务的培训;一个稀少的、有条件的路由器,然后在推出过程中学会结合这些路由,使用预测器的培训目标,没有专家指定标签。

blocks.en: On VBVR-Pro-Bench, VR-JEPA improves overall task success from 50.3% for VBVR-Wan2.2 to 56.0%. Component ablations support the contributions of localized contrastive-state learning and skill routed mixture of experts. Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce VR-JEPA, a framework that predicts task-relevant latent trajectories from V-JEPA features and uses them to guide video generation, separating state evolution prediction from visual synthesis. • We develop localized contrastive-state learning (LCL), which uses feature discrepancies between successful reference trajectories and task-matched generated candidates to focus contrastive supervision on informative states and tokens. • We develop a skill-routed mixture of experts (SR-MoE) for latent prediction. Anchor-task-trained residual experts are combined by a sparse, state-conditioned router to adapt to heterogeneous state transitions without expert-assignment labels.

The Latent Reasoner predicts a latent rollout from the initial scene and task instruction, with SR-MoE adaptively selecting expert combinations for different reasoning tasks. Its seven experts cover VIS (visual discrimination), NUM (numerical reasoning), IDN (object identity and persistence), SPA (spatial reasoning and planning), DYN (physical dynamics), CMP (compositional reasoning), and ABS (abstract rule inference). During predictor training, localized contrastive-state learning uses dense V-JEPA discrepancies between successful and generated videos to focus contrastive supervision on tokens corresponding to informative states and regions. The Video Generator conditions Wan2.2 DiT on the rollout to synthesize a reasoning video.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA)
blocks.zh: 2.1 联合规划建筑

blocks.en:
Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) learns representations by predicting target embeddings from contextual observations.
I-JEPA introduces this approach for images, and V-JEPA extends it to spatiotemporal representations ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) .
V-JEPA 2 demonstrates latent prediction for video understanding and action-conditioned planning ( Assran et al., 2025 ) .
Recent work extends JEPA to reasoning and generation.
JEPA-Reasoner separates latent reasoning from text generation, while ThinkJEPA incorporates vision-language reasoning features into latent world modeling ( Liu and Chen, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
For video generation, WMReward uses V-JEPA prediction consistency for candidate selection and sampling guidance, while Off-Manifold Refinement refines generation trajectories with prediction-energy gradients ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Nguyen-Truong et al., 2026 ) .
PhysVideoGenerator predicts V-JEPA features from noisy diffusion latents and injects them into the generator ( Satish et al., 2026 ) .
These generation approaches primarily target physical plausibility.
VR-JEPA focuses on visual problem solving, adapting a JEPA predictor through localized contrastive-state learning and skill specialization to produce latent trajectories that condition video generation.
blocks.zh:
联合预测架构(JEPA)通过预测从背景观察中嵌入的目标来学习表现.
I-JEPA在图像中引入了这种方法,V-JEPA将其扩展至瞬间表达(Asran等人,2023年;Bardes等人,2024年)。
V-JEPA 2显示了对视频理解和有行动条件规划的潜在预测(Asran等人,2025年)。
最近的工作将JEPA扩展到推理和生成.
JEPA-Reasoner将潜在推理与文本生成区分开来,而ThinkJEPA则将视觉语言推理特征纳入潜在世界模型(刘和陈,2025;张等人,2026).
对于视频生成,WMREWORD使用V-JEPA预测一致性来进行候选选择和取样指导,而Off-Maniver Finement则用预测-能量梯度来完善生成轨迹(Yuan等人,2026年;Nguyen-Truong等人,2026年).
PhysVideoGenerator预测V-JEPA的特性来自吵闹的扩散潜伏,并注入生成器(Satish等人,2026年)。
这些生成方法主要针对物理可信性.
VR-JEPA侧重于视觉问题的解决,通过局部对比态的学习和技能专门化来调整JEPA的预测器,以产生潜在的轨道,为视频生成提供条件.

blocks.en: 2.2 Visual Reasoning through Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 通过世代实现视觉理性

blocks.en:
Visual generation provides a medium for expressing intermediate states during problem solving. Wiedemer et al. (2025) demonstrate emergent zero-shot perception, manipulation, and reasoning capabilities in video models.
Thinking with Video further examines generation-based reasoning through VideoThinkBench, covering both vision-centric and text-centric tasks ( Tong et al., 2026 ) .
Moving toward systematic training and evaluation, VBVR introduces large-scale reasoning data, verifiable scoring, and scaling studies with VBVR-Wan2.2 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
VBVR-Pro extends this direction to native visual reasoning across generation modalities and evaluates transfer to external benchmarks ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
Beyond establishing these capabilities, recent approaches improve video reasoning through explicit feedback.
Wan-R1 studies verifiable reinforcement learning for spatial reasoning and planning, while VLMs are Good Teachers uses a vision-language model to formulate rewards for test-time optimization of a video generator ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) .
These approaches motivate supervision that evaluates task correctness beyond visual plausibility.
Our work takes a complementary route by learning reasoning guidance within a latent predictor.
Rather than applying correctness feedback only to the generator, VR-JEPA uses successful and contrastive trajectories to train intermediate state predictions, which subsequently guide the generation of visual solutions.
blocks.zh:
视觉生成提供了在解决问题时表达中间状态的介质. Wiedemer等人(2025年)在视频模型中演示了新兴的零镜头感知,操纵,和推理能力.
与Video一起思考进一步通过VideoThink Bench审查基于世代的推理,既包括以视觉为中心的任务,也包括以文字为中心的任务(Tong等人,2026年).
VBVR向系统培训和评估迈进,引入了大规模推理数据,可核查的评分,并用VBVR-Wan2.2(Wang等人,2026年)进行规模化研究.
VBVR-Pro将这个方向延伸至本土视觉推理跨代模式,并评价转移到外部基准(徐等人,2026年).
除了建立这些能力外,最近的办法通过明确的反馈改进了视频推理。
Wan-R1为空间推理和规划研究可核查的强化学习,而VLMs是好教师则使用视觉语言模型来制定视频生成器测试时间优化的奖励(刘等人,2026年;程等人,2026年).
这些方法激励了对任务正确性的评价超出视觉可信度的监督。
我们的工作通过在潜在预测器内学习推理指导,采取互补的方式。
VR-JEPA不只对生成器应用正确性反馈,而是使用成功和对比性的轨迹来训练中间态预测,从而指导视觉解决方案的生成.

blocks.zh: 3.2 地方化的反政府学习

V-JEPA’s general spatiotemporal priors may not emphasize the state transitions and regions critical to visual reasoning.
To address this limitation, VR-JEPA introduces localized contrastive-state learning (LCL), which compares successful videos with task-matched generated candidates in dense V-JEPA feature space, identifies informative states and regions, and strengthens contrastive supervision on the corresponding latent tokens.

blocks.en: A compact V-JEPA predictor may lack the capacity to model the diverse reasoning patterns required across tasks. To address this limitation, VR-JEPA equips the predictor with a lightweight skill-routed mixture of experts, which adaptively selects different expert combinations for different tasks.

The router is trained through the prediction and contrastive-state objectives, without expert-assignment annotations for the full training set or additional load-balancing losses.
Training first optimizes the router with fixed experts, then jointly adapts the router and experts, and finally updates selected shared components.
This progression learns how to combine the initialized experts before refining their capabilities and coordination beyond the anchor tasks.
The resulting adaptive composition supports latent rollout prediction for tasks requiring multiple reasoning skills.

blocks.en: We evaluate VR-JEPA on VBVR-Pro-Bench ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , which comprises 100 visual reasoning tasks spanning abstraction, knowledge, perception, spatial reasoning, and transformation. We evaluate five instances per task, totaling 500 instances. Given an initial image and an instruction, models generate a video depicting the solution. The benchmark includes 50 in-domain (ID) tasks from task families represented in its training set and 50 held-out out-of-domain (OOD) tasks. Task-specific, rule-based evaluators assess generated outputs against the required outcomes and constraints. We report overall, ID/OOD, and category-level scores; absolute gains are expressed in percentage points.

blocks.en: The publicly released baseline outputs for VBVR-Pro-Bench differ in frame count and spatial resolution. We rerun VBVR-Wan2.2 on VBVR-Pro-Bench. Before evaluation, we temporally sample each generated video to match the frame count of its corresponding ground-truth video and resize the frames to 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. We apply this preprocessing to outputs from all compared methods and recompute their scores using the same evaluation pipeline, ensuring a consistent comparison.

blocks.en: VR-JEPA is trained in two stages. First, the Latent Reasoner is trained with the V-JEPA 2.1 encoder ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) frozen. The learnable pooler and predictor are optimized using the prediction and localized contrastive-state objectives described in Section 3.2 , with expert training and routing detailed in Section 3.3 . Second, the Latent Reasoner is frozen, and the Wan2.2-14B generator, initialized from VBVR-Wan2.2, is adapted by optimizing only the LoRA parameters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) and rollout-conditioning modules with a flow-matching loss ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) . Additional implementation details are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 reports quantitative comparisons on VBVR-Pro-Bench. VR-JEPA achieves the highest overall score of 56.0% among the evaluated models, outperforming VBVR-Wan2.2 by 5.7 percentage points and Seedance 2.0, the highest-scoring proprietary model overall, by 7.5 points. Compared with VBVR-Wan2.2, it improves the ID average from 55.4% to 65.9% and the OOD average from 45.1% to 46.1%. In particular, ID abstraction and perception improve by 22.5 and 10.9 points, reaching 56.3% and 61.8%, respectively. ID knowledge and spatial reasoning also improve by 9.0 and 3.2 points, while transformation performance remains nearly unchanged at 91.4%. These gains over VBVR-Wan2.2 support the effectiveness of the proposed latent reasoning framework, which combines supervision on informative states and regions with adaptive skill-expert composition. Section 4.3 examines the contributions of localized contrastive-state learning and SR-MoE individually and jointly.
blocks.zh: 表1报告了VBVR-Pro-Bench的定量比较。 VR-JEPA在被评价模型中总得分最高,达到56.0%,比VBVR-Wan2.2的成绩高5.7个百分点,种子2.0,是总得分最高的专利模型,总得分7.5分. 与VBVR-Wan2.2相比,它提高了ID的平均水平,从55.4%提高到65.9%,而OD的平均水平从45.1%提高到46.1%。 特别是ID抽象度和感知度分别提高22.5和10.9分,分别达到56.3%和61.8%. ID知识和空间推理也提高了9.0和3.2分,而转化性能几乎保持不变,保持在91.4%。 与VBVR-Wan2.2相比取得的这些进展支持了拟议的潜在推理框架的有效性,该框架将监督信息丰富的国家和区域与适应性技能专家构成结合起来。 第4.3节审查地方性对比性状态学习和性健康和生殖健康教育的贡献。

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares VR-JEPA with VBVR-Wan2.2, LTX-2.3-I2AV, Kling VIDEO 3.0, and Seedance 2.0 on four visual reasoning examples. In the ball-bouncing task, VR-JEPA produces a trajectory closely matching the ground truth, whereas VBVR-Wan2.2 follows an incorrect initial direction and the other models produce curved or irregular paths. In the shape-sorting task, VR-JEPA preserves the objects and groups them by type in ascending size order. By contrast, VBVR-Wan2.2 interleaves the two shape groups, while LTX-2.3-I2AV alters object shapes and colors. In the transformation task, VR-JEPA correctly applies the demonstrated color change followed by size reduction to the bottom-row ellipses. VBVR-Wan2.2 leaves the answer positions unfilled, while Kling VIDEO 3.0 and Seedance 2.0 change the final ellipse into a circle. In the sequence-completion task, VR-JEPA circles the same option as the ground truth, whereas VBVR-Wan2.2 circles the red distractor and Seedance 2.0 modifies the sequence instead of marking an answer option. Together, these examples highlight VR-JEPA’s advantage over the compared models in following task rules while preserving relevant object attributes, yielding reasoning outputs more consistent with the intended solutions.
blocks.zh: 图4将VR-JEPA与VBVR-Wan2.2,LTX-2.3-I2AV,Kling VIDEO 3.0,以及种子2.0四个视觉推理例子进行比较. 在弹球任务中,VR-JEPA产生一个与地面真理紧密匹配的轨迹,而VBVR-Wan2.2则遵循错误的初始方向,其他模型产生弯曲或不规则路径. 在形状排序任务中,VR-JEPA按照上升大小顺序按类型保存对象并进行组合. 相比之下,VBVR-Wan2.2介于两个形状组之间,而LTX-2.3-I2AV则改变物体的形状和颜色. 在变换任务中,VR-JEPA正确地将所显示的颜色变化,继而缩小的大小,应用到下行椭圆上. VBVR-Wan2.2让答案位置未填充,而Kling VIDEO 3.0和种子2.0则将最终椭圆改变为圆形. 在序列-补全任务中,VR-JEPA环绕与地面真理相同的选项,而VBVR-Wan2.2环绕红色分散器和种子2.0修改序列而不是标记一个答案选项. 这些例子一起突出了VR-JEPA在遵循任务规则的同时保留相关对象属性,产生更符合预期解决方案的推理产出方面,比比较模型的优势.

blocks.en: The dense baseline guides Wan2.2 video generation with latent rollouts predicted by a trained V-JEPA predictor. The three variants add localized contrastive-state learning (LCL), SR-MoE, or both to this baseline. Table 3 shows that LCL and SR-MoE individually raise the overall score from 53.9% to 55.1% and 55.5%, respectively. Combining both achieves the best overall, ID, and OOD averages among the ablated variants: 56.0%, 65.9%, and 46.1%. Figure 5 illustrates these benefits: LCL corrects the mirrored checkerboard completion, while SR-MoE selects the instructed pentagon instead of a distractor. Combining both also enables the model to identify the second-largest circle, which the LCL-only variant fails to select. Together, these results support the complementary benefits of supervision focused on informative states and regions and skill-specific expert routing in improving VR-JEPA’s video reasoning.
blocks.zh: 密集的基线为Wan2.2视频生成提供了指导,由经过培训的V-JEPA预测器预测潜在的推出。 三种变体将本地化的对比态学习(LCL),SR-MoE,或两者都加入到这个基线中. 表3显示,LCL和SR-MOE个人将总分分别从53.9%提高到55.1%和55.5%。 两者结合,在减速变种中实现总体最佳的ID和OOD平均值:56.0%、65.9%和46.1%。 图5说明了这些好处: LCL校正了镜像的跳棋补全,而SR-MoE则选择指示的五角星,而不是一个分光符. 两者结合,也使模型能够识别第二大圆,而仅LCL的变体未能选择. 这些结果共同支持了注重信息丰富的国家和地区的监督的互补效益,以及改善VR-JEPA的视频推理方面的技能专家路线。

blocks.en: Table 3 compares DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) and V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) as representation spaces for latent reasoning under the same framework, with initial-state DINOv3 features included as a reference. The selected DINOv3 and V-JEPA 2.1 encoders have comparable parameter counts. Using V-JEPA 2.1 for latent rollout prediction achieves video reasoning scores of 65.9% on ID tasks and 46.1% on OOD tasks, outperforming the DINOv3 rollout variant by 0.6 and 2.3 percentage points, respectively. These results favor V-JEPA 2.1 for video reasoning, consistent with its ability to capture spatiotemporal dynamics beyond the static visual semantics primarily encoded by DINOv3. Corresponding qualitative comparisons are provided in Figure 9 in Appendix C.3 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented VR-JEPA, a framework that predicts latent rollouts in V-JEPA representation space to guide video generation for visual reasoning. VR-JEPA uses localized contrastive-state learning to focus contrastive supervision on informative states and regions identified from successful reference videos and task-matched generated candidates. It further equips the predictor with a skill-routed mixture of experts that adaptively combines skill-specific experts for different reasoning tasks. On VBVR-Pro-Bench, VR-JEPA improves the overall score from 50.3% to 56.0% over VBVR-Wan2.2, an absolute gain of 5.7 percentage points. Component ablations support the complementary contributions of localized supervision and skill-expert composition. Together, these results highlight the potential of reasoning-guided latent prediction for reasoning through video generation.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了VR-JEPA,这是一个预测V-JEPA代表空间潜在推出的框架,用以指导视频生成进行视觉推理. VR-JEPA利用局部对比性状态学习,将对比性监督的重点放在从成功的参考视频和任务匹配生成的候选人中找出的信息丰富的国家和地区。 它进一步为预测者配备了技能路线的专家混合体,使技能特异性专家适应性地结合,执行不同的推理任务. 在VBVR-Pro-Bench上,VR-JEPA比VBVR-Wan2.2的总得分从50.3%提高到56.0%,绝对增益5.7个百分点. 构成部分组合支持地方监督和技能专家组成的互补贡献。 这些结果共同突出了通过视频生成推理指导的潜在预测的潜力。

blocks.en: A.1 Training Data
blocks.zh: A.1 培训数据

blocks.en: Our training corpus comprises 100 tasks with 1,000 samples per task. Each sample contains an initial state, a task instruction, and a successful reference trajectory. These 100,000 reference samples support latent reasoner training in Stage 1 and video generator adaptation in Stage 2. For localized contrastive-state learning, we additionally generate one negative candidate per sample using VBVR-Wan2.2 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) under the same initial state and instruction, yielding 100,000 positive–negative trajectory pairs. Since generated candidates may also satisfy the task, our localization mechanism identifies informative differences within these pairs for supervision. Of the 100 training tasks, 50 are included in the ID evaluation using held-out instances. The 50 OOD evaluation tasks are absent from the training corpus.
blocks.zh: 我们的训练团包括100项任务,每个任务有1 000个样本。 每个样本包含初始状态,任务指令,以及成功的参考轨迹. 这100 000个参考样本支持第一阶段的潜在理性培训和第二阶段的视频生成器改造。 对于本地化的对比状态学习,我们利用VBVR-Wan2.2(Wang等人,2026年)在相同的初始状态和指令下,每个样本产生一个负候选人,产生100,000正负轨道对。 由于产生的候选人也可能完成这项任务,我们的本地化机制查明了这两对候选人在信息方面的差异,以供监督。 在100项培训任务中,有50项利用搁置情况列入身份证评估。 50项食品评估任务没有列入培训大纲。

blocks.en: For expert pretraining, we first define the reasoning skill associated with each of the seven experts and manually select seven representative anchor tasks for that skill from the same corpus. The task subsets are disjoint across experts, yielding 49 anchor tasks and 49,000 reference samples in total. Each expert is pretrained on its corresponding subset to establish an initial skill specialization. Subsequent router training and joint refinement cover all 100 tasks without additional task-to-expert annotations.
blocks.zh: 就专家预训而言,我们首先界定了与7名专家中的每一位有关的推理技能,并手动从同一机构为这一技能选择了7个有代表性的主干任务。 任务子集是专家之间脱节的,总共产生49项主干任务和49 000个参考样本。 每位专家都接受相应子集的预先培训,以便建立初步的技能专业化。 随后的路由器培训和联合改进涵盖了所有100项任务,而没有额外的任务对专家的说明.

blocks.en: A.2 Architecture and Training Procedure
blocks.zh: A.2 建筑和培训程序

blocks.en: We initialize the visual encoder from the V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) checkpoint vjepa2_1_vitl_dist_vitG_384.pt , loading its ema_encoder weights. The encoder remains frozen throughout both training stages. The state-token pooler and six-layer task-relevant latent predictor are trained for our framework rather than initialized from the pretrained V-JEPA predictor. For Stage 2, we initialize the video generator from VBVR-Wan2.2 and adapt its high-noise branch, while retaining the low-noise branch.
blocks.zh: 我们从 V-JEPA 2.1 VIT-L(Mur-Labadia et al., 2026) 检查站 vjepa2_1_vitl_dist_vitG_384.pt 初始化视觉编码器,装入其ema_encoder重量. 编码器在两个培训阶段都冻结。 国家数据库的共享器和六层与任务相关的潜在预测器是为我们的框架而培训的,而不是从经过预先培训的V-JEPA预测器中初始化的。 对于阶段2,我们从VBVR-Wan2.2初始化视频生成器,并调整其高噪分机,同时保留低噪分机.

blocks.en: Seven bottleneck-adapter experts are inserted into the final two predictor blocks. Their designated skills are visual discrimination (VIS), numerical reasoning (NUM), object identity and persistence (IDN), spatial reasoning and planning (SPA), physical dynamics (DYN), compositional reasoning (CMP), and abstract rule inference (ABS). Routing uses Entmax 1.5 \operatorname{Entmax}_{1.5} ( Peters et al., 2019 ) and the objectives in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 七个瓶颈适应器专家被插入最后两个预测器块. 他们指定的技能是视觉歧视(VIS)、数字推理(NUM)、物体身份和持久性(IDN)、空间推理和规划(SPA)、物理动态(DYN)、组成推理(CMP)和抽象规则推论(ABS)。 routing使用Entmax 1.5\operatorname{Entmax}_{1.5}(Peters等人,2019年)和第3.3节的目标.

blocks.en: We use a history window of H = 4 H=4 states and represent each state with M = 8 M=8 tokens of dimension d = 256 d=256 . The pooler has N h = 8 N_{h}=8 attention heads. Each rollout contains ten states including the initial state, corresponding to a prediction horizon of T = 9 T=9 in Equation 1 . Early stopping is disabled. The two-step prediction and VISReg weights in Equation 3 are λ 2 = 2.0 \lambda_{2}=2.0 and λ reg = 10 − 4 \lambda_{\mathrm{reg}}=10^{-4} , respectively. The expert residual coefficient in Equation 7 is fixed to α = 1 \alpha=1 ; the implementation adds the routed expert output directly to the shared feed-forward output, without learning or scheduling a separate residual scale.

blocks.en: Latent reasoner training consists of base training, expert pretraining, router initialization, and two successive joint refinement phases. All phases use AdamW with β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , and an effective global batch size of 512. Learning rates follow a linear warmup followed by cosine decay. The V-JEPA encoder remains frozen in every phase.

blocks.en: A.4 Parameter Overhead
blocks.zh: A.4 超头参数

blocks.en: VR-JEPA is initialized from VBVR-Wan2.2 and inherits its 306.708M LoRA parameters across the two generator branches (153.354M per branch). The underlying Wan2.2 DiT contains 28.578B parameters, with approximately 14.289B per branch. Our latent predictor contains 38.093M parameters, including the SR-MoE experts and router. The trajectory-conditioning interface adds 17.181M parameters: 11.807M for the semantic memory adapter and 5.374M for the rollout modulation adapter. Relative to VBVR-Wan2.2, the predictor and conditioning modules therefore add 55.274M parameters, equivalent to approximately 0.19% of the underlying 28.578B-parameter DiT. Relative to the original Wan2.2 DiT, the inherited LoRA parameters and these new modules together account for 361.982M additional parameters, approximately 1.27% of the DiT parameter count.
blocks.zh: VR-JEPA由VBVR-Wan2.2初始化,继承其306.708M LORA参数跨越两个发电机分支(每分支153.354M). 基础的Wan2.2 DiT包含28.578B参数,每个分支约有14.289B. 我们的潜在预测器包含38.093M参数,包括SR-MoE专家和路由器. 轨迹调节接口增加了17.181M参数:11.807M用于语义内存适配器,5.374M用于推出调制适配器. 相对于VBVR-Wan2.2,预测和调节模块因此增加了55.274M参数,相当于基础28.578B参数DiT的约0.19%. 相对于原Wan2.2DiT,继承的LORA参数和这些新模块加起来占361.982M参数,约占DiT参数数的1.27%.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , VR-JEPA improves the overall score from 50.3% to 56.0% over VBVR-Wan2.2 with only 55.274M additional predictor and conditioning parameters beyond that baseline; the inherited LoRA parameters are already present in VBVR-Wan2.2. This small overhead supports a design that emphasizes informative contrastive supervision through LCL and adaptive skill-expert composition through SR-MoE, rather than substantial model expansion.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,VR-JEPA的总得分比VBVR-Wan2.2提高50.3%至56.0%,只有55274M的附加预测和调节参数超出基准;继承的LORA参数已经存在于VBVR-Wan2.2中. 这种小的间接费用支持一种设计,通过LCL强调信息化的对比性监督,并通过SR-MOE强调适应性技能专家构成,而不是实质性的模型扩展.

blocks.en: Table 6 examines whether the generator uses the content of the predicted rollout by changing its trajectory input while keeping the observation, instruction, and sampling seed fixed. Removing trajectory conditioning reduces ID performance from 65.9% to 51.5%, a drop of 14.4 percentage points. Replacing the predicted rollout with one from another sample yields 58.5%, a drop of 7.4 points despite retaining the conditioning pathway. This comparison indicates that the ID benefit depends in part on the correspondence between the rollout and the current sample, beyond the mere presence of an additional conditioning signal. The effect is smaller on OOD tasks: removing conditioning lowers the score from 46.1% to 44.9%, whereas cross-sample substitution yields 45.9%, close to the original score. Thus, sample-matched rollout content contributes more clearly to ID performance, consistent with the smaller OOD gains in the main evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表6通过改变轨道输入,同时保持观测、指示和取样种子的固定,审查发电机是否使用预测推出的内容。 取消轨迹条件使ID性能从65.9%降至51.5%,下降了14.4个百分点. 以另一个样本取代预测的推出,产量为58.5%,尽管保留了调节路径,但下降了7.4点。 这一比较表明,ID的好处部分取决于推出和当前样本之间的对应关系,而不是仅仅存在附加条件信号。 对OOD任务的影响较小:去除条件使得分从46.1%降至44.9%,而跨样本替代则得到45.9%,接近原始得分. 因此,与主要评价中较小的OD收益相一致,样本匹配的推出内容更清楚地有助于识别性能。

blocks.en: Figure 10 compares generations conditioned on the predicted rollout with three interventions: removing trajectory conditioning, repeating the initial state, and substituting another sample’s rollout. In the upper example, predicted-rollout conditioning more closely follows the reference sequence of shape and attribute changes, whereas the interventions introduce mismatches in intermediate or final states. In the maze example, the predicted-rollout result more closely follows the reference path, while the intervened results deviate at the locations marked in red. Removing conditioning tests the presence of trajectory guidance; repeating the initial state tests whether its temporal evolution matters; and substituting another sample’s rollout tests the importance of instance-specific content. These examples illustrate the different failure modes, while the quantitative intervention results are needed to assess how consistently they occur.
blocks.zh: 图10比较了以预测推出为条件的几代人与三种干预措施:去除轨迹调节,重复初始状态,以及替代另一个样本推出。 在上例中,预测的滚出条件更紧密地跟随形状和属性变化的参考序列,而干预则引入中间状态或最终状态的错配. 在迷宫例子中,预测的推出结果更紧密地遵循参考路径,而干预结果则在以红色标注的地点偏离. 删除条件测试轨迹引导的存在; 重复初始状态测试其时间进化是否重要; 并取代另一个样本的推出测试特定实例内容的重要性. 这些例子说明了不同的失败模式,同时需要量化干预结果来评估这些模式是如何一致发生的。

blocks.en: C.5 Task-Dependent Expert Routing
blocks.zh: C.5 任务依赖专家路线

blocks.en: Figure 11 visualizes the mean routing weights for ten tasks, averaged across layer4 and layer5, the two SR-MoE blocks of the latent predictor. The task-dependent distributions are broadly consistent with the experts’ designated skills. Maze navigation and LEGO assembly assign nearly all routing weight to SPA (0.993) and CMP (0.998), respectively, while gravity and bouncing favors DYN (0.688). Unique-shape identification assigns its largest weight to VIS, object-to-target matching to IDN, and next-color prediction and sequence completion to ABS.
blocks.zh: 图11可视化十项任务的平均路由权重,平均跨层4和层5,潜在预测器的两个SR-MoE区块. 取决于任务的分配与专家的指定技能大体一致。 Maze导航和LEGO组装分别将几乎所有的路由重量分配给SPA(0.993)和CMP(0.998),而重力和弹力则有利于DYN(0.688)。 独特的形状识别将其最大重量分配到VIS,对象对目标匹配到IDN,下色预测和序列完成则分配到ABS.

blocks.en: Figure 11: Task-dependent expert routing. Mean routing weights for ten tasks, averaged across the two SR-MoE predictor layers (layer4 and layer5). Rows denote tasks and columns denote the seven skill-specific experts; darker cells indicate larger weights. The distributions show both concentrated expert selection and allocations spread across multiple experts.
blocks.zh: 图11:任务专家路线。 10项任务的平均路由权重,平均跨越两个SR-MoE预测层(层4和层5). 行表示任务,列表示七位技能特异的专家;较暗的单元格表示较大的权重. 分布显示专家集中挑选和分配分散在多个专家之间。

blocks.en: Other tasks distribute substantial average weight across several experts. Sliding puzzle allocates weight primarily to SPA (0.634) and CMP (0.279), while shortest directed-graph path draws on SPA (0.408), VIS (0.278), and NUM (0.247). These patterns are consistent with task-dependent expert composition rather than a fixed assignment of every task to a single expert. The averages summarize expert utilization rather than establish each expert’s causal contribution; the removal analysis in Section C.6 provides complementary evidence by examining the effects of suppressing a selected expert.
blocks.zh: 其他任务在几位专家中分配了大量平均重量。 滑动的谜题主要将重量分配给SPA(0.634)和CMP(0.279),而最短的定向绘图路径则借鉴SPA(0.408),VIS(0.278)和NUM(0.247). 这些模式符合以任务为依托的专家构成,而不是将每一项任务固定分配给一名专家。 平均数总结了专家的利用情况,而不是确定每位专家的因果关系;C.6节的清除分析通过审查压制选定的专家的效果提供了补充证据。

blocks.en: C.6 Skill-specific expert removal
blocks.zh: C.6 特定技能专家的解职

blocks.en: Figure 12 compares learned routing with removal of the highest-weight expert in seven selected examples, ordered by the designated skills VIS, NUM, IDN, SPA, DYN, CMP, and ABS. The interventions produce several distinct errors. Border completion leaves a shape unoutlined; ordinal selection marks the largest circle instead of the second-largest; and shape sorting duplicates a small red square. The maze output includes an invalid path, and the domino output propagates beyond the marked gap. The final two examples select the wrong size in a shape-color sequence and the wrong color in a repeating cycle.
blocks.zh: 图12比较了七个选定例子中最重专家的学习路线和除名情况,这些例子由指定的技能VIS、NUM、IDN、SPA、DYN、CMP和ABS订购。 这些干预措施产生了若干明显错误。 边框完成后留下一个未外线的形状;正弦选择标志最大的圆而不是第二大;形状排序重复一个小的红色方块. 迷宫输出包括一条无效路径,多米诺输出传播到标记差距之外. 最后两个例子在形状-颜色序列中选择错误的大小,在重复周期中选择错误的颜色.

blocks.en: These errors are consistent with the reasoning operations associated with the removed experts and provide qualitative evidence of differentiated contributions. Because the experiment removes the highest-weight expert in selected examples, it does not establish an exclusive mapping between each expert and one skill or separate skill specificity from general sensitivity to removing a strongly weighted expert.
blocks.zh: 这些错误与被解职专家的推理操作一致,并提供了不同贡献的定性证据。 由于实验清除了所选例子中重量最高的专家,因此它没有在每位专家与一种技能之间建立独家的映射,或者将技能特异性与一般敏感度区分开来,以去除一位高度加权的专家.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Probing expert specialization through skill removal. We remove the highest-weight expert for each of seven examples and examine whether the resulting errors reflect the loss of its associated reasoning skill. From top to bottom, the removed experts correspond to visual discrimination, numerical reasoning, object identity and persistence, spatial reasoning and planning, physical dynamics, compositional reasoning, and abstract rule inference. Green and red dashed boxes highlight correct results and reasoning errors, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图12:通过技能脱颖而试探专家专业化. 我们取消了7个例子中每个例子的最高重量专家,并审查由此产生的错误是否反映了其相关推理技能的丧失。 从上到下,被移除的专家对应视觉歧视,数字推理,对象身份和持久性,空间推理和规划,物理动态,组成推理,以及抽象规则推论. 绿色和红色破碎的框分别突出正确结果和推理错误.
